attempt_policy.analysis_method: Project the exact public pre-shot v2 failure and the executor regression contract.
attempt_policy.decision_rule: Create new attempt identities under plan v3, retain one attempt per slot, and require readiness to anchor live-relative actions before normalization.
attempt_policy.observed_range_or_uncertainty: All 18 public non-final v2 attempts failed before a shot with one action-normalization error; no physics or termination outcome was observed.
attempt_policy.rationale: The successor is a new determination, not a retry within consumed plan v2.

capability_quotas.analysis_method: Apply every accepted per-rollout central capture, observation, validation and derivation path to all 24 attempts, with one deterministic replay proof per lineage.
capability_quotas.decision_rule: Require 24 validated rollout paths for per-rollout capabilities and 4 replay proofs, one per frozen lineage.
capability_quotas.observed_range_or_uncertainty: Issue 51 passed every central capability and two non-final replay collections; production-scale failure rates remain uncertain.
capability_quotas.rationale: Capability coverage is explicit and cannot be inferred from rollout counts alone.

coverage_quotas.analysis_method: Scale the accepted six-stratum pilot requirement uniformly across all four frozen exposure roles.
coverage_quotas.decision_rule: Require one planned intervention per central stratum per role; do not fill quotas from realized outcomes.
coverage_quotas.observed_range_or_uncertainty: Each of six central strata passed with actual Unity evidence; the pilot did not estimate a stratum prevalence.
coverage_quotas.rationale: Twenty-four fixed attempts cover every required role/stratum pair without outcome-conditioned resampling.

intervention_actions.analysis_method: Reuse exact accepted slingshot-relative actions from the issue-44/48/51 pilot records and preserve both interface and engine-relative forms.
intervention_actions.decision_rule: Freeze those four accepted offsets; duplicate an action only as a distinct planned rollout with a distinct intended stratum.
intervention_actions.observed_range_or_uncertainty: Accepted offsets were [77,29], [-77,29], [-74,-31], and [-77,30] pixels with tap 0 ms and hold 1000 ms; transfer to other frozen lineages remains a prospective coverage assignment, not an outcome guarantee.
intervention_actions.rationale: The accepted actions supply geometry-aware and targeted sources without inventing benchmark-agent provenance.

noncentral_dispositions.analysis_method: Project the accepted secondary, optional and out-of-scope dispositions without promoting them into central quotas.
noncentral_dispositions.decision_rule: Assign no placeholder quotas and do not emit excluded predicates as false.
noncentral_dispositions.observed_range_or_uncertainty: The accepted pilot recorded bounded negative, material, physical-regime and other secondary capabilities as not required; benchmark-agent action provenance was unavailable.
noncentral_dispositions.rationale: The plan remains limited to the approved central joint-controller experiment.

partition_quotas.analysis_method: Exact projection of the four accepted issue-47 role assignments revalidated by issue 51.
partition_quotas.decision_rule: Assign one frozen lineage and six planned interventions to each accepted exposure role.
partition_quotas.observed_range_or_uncertainty: Four roles, four distinct lineages and level instances, two benchmark conditions and two source templates; final evaluation remained sealed and unconsumed.
partition_quotas.rationale: This preserves the accepted instance-held-out exposure manifest while giving every role the same prospective central-stratum coverage.

termination_quotas.analysis_method: Project the exact public non-final v3 role/intervention termination map and transfer only calibration expectations to the fresh type010102 final lineage.
termination_quotas.decision_rule: Require 4 assignment-bound level_fail and 20 stable_entered terminations; do not consult sealed v3 outcomes.
termination_quotas.observed_range_or_uncertainty: Public v3 contains 18 accepted non-final rollouts: 4 level_fail and 14 stable_entered; seed 4504 remains prospective.
termination_quotas.rationale: This retains all actions and non-final lineages while matching demonstrated engine termination semantics without post-hoc final tuning.
